# The legacy EWS junk fallback distinguishes returned IDs from required resynchronization

Below Exchange2013, a supplied destination lets the junk operation await a regular MoveItem. The destination is Junk for junk and Inbox for unjunk. Returned IDs produce Some; required resync produces None, which becomes an empty ID list plus the legacy-fallback flag. That flag describes missing IDs/resync rather than every older server version. The initial folder callback requests only destination synchronization and returns before sync completion; current adds source sync later. No-ID callback completion is not complete local reconciliation or server spam learning. No operation or legacy test ran.

Scope: Older Exchange junk destination and no-ID completion.
